title: 第7章 今日为国杀你第8章 邹云真义士也
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
不一会，二人就带着东西，返回刚才的院落。
此时，邹云正蹲在地上，背对院门，对着一个粗粝的石臼捣鼓着什么。
他的衣袖高高挽起，露出沾满灰黑色粉末的小臂，额角渗着细密汗珠。
随着他每一次用力的捣杵，石臼发出沉闷而有节奏的“咚...咚...”声，细小粉尘在光线中飞舞。
邹云仿佛隔绝了外界的一切，沉浸在自己的世界里。
“你要的东西！”
扶苏径直走到邹云身旁，俯下身，将包裹递到他手边。
即使是在这样的情境下，他的动作依旧带着一种符合礼仪的优雅。
而蒙毅则紧随其后，目光扫视着四周，警惕任何可能的异动。
邹云头也未抬，仿佛早已知晓他们的到来，直接伸手接过东西。
并且看也不看，直接一股脑儿倾入另外两个石臼，随后更加卖力地研磨起来。
杵棒与坚硬矿物摩擦，发出刺耳的“嘎吱”声。
见他完全沉浸在手头的东西上，对外界置若罔闻。扶苏忍不住又靠近几步，弯腰盯着石臼神色莫名道：
“方师，你这是要做什么？莫非......这就是方士追求长生的秘术？”
突然在耳边炸响的声音，惊得邹云浑身一颤，他手猛地一抖，差点没把石臼打翻出去。
“什么鬼？！”
邹云猛地抬头，额上沁出更多细汗，眼中满是受惊后的茫然。
待看清是刚才的二人后，那点茫然迅速被不悦取代。
“怎么还没走啊！！！不是说了不让问的嘛？”
邹云眉头紧锁，说话的语气急促烦躁，显然对扶苏的突然发问极为不满。

扶苏也被他这过激的反应吓了一跳，身体下意识后退半步。
这位向来温文尔雅的长公子，显然没料到对方会如此失态。
不过盯着邹云眼中的愠色，扶苏立刻意识到自己的唐突，脸上掠过一丝歉意。
“是在下冒昧，惊扰方师了，还请见谅。”
随即对着邹云也是连连拱手致歉，姿态放得极低。
“罢了罢了！”
见扶苏态度谦和诚恳，邹云胸中的火气也消了大半，他略显不耐地摆了摆手，算是揭过此事。
就在扶苏松了口气，继续观摩邹云手上动作时。
突然，邹云随手一指旁边的石臼，示意扶苏去研磨另一份材料。
“喏，闲着也是闲着，你去把那堆也磨了！”末了还不忘强调，“要细，越细越好！”
那语气，仿佛在吩咐一个学徒。
“啊？......”
扶苏显然没料到会有此一举，脸上闪过一丝错愕。
可还没等他将婉拒的话说出口，一个沾满矿粉的石臼便不由分说地塞进了他怀中。
冰凉的粗粝感，透过丝帛传到他身上，呛人的粉尘，瞬间污染他身上那件华贵衣袍。
而石臼沉甸甸的手感，更是让这位养尊处优的公子被压得一个踉跄，几乎站立不稳。
“愣着干嘛，快去啊！！”
可邹云却只是不耐烦地催促着，仿佛扶苏的迟疑耽误了他的大事。
面对这近乎无礼的催促，这位素来恪守礼仪的大秦长公子，竟罕见地愣了一下。
content_en:
After a while, the two took their things and returned to the courtyard.
At this time, Zou Yun was squatting on the ground, with his back to the courtyard door, tinkering with a rough stone mortar.
His sleeves were rolled up high, revealing his forearms covered with gray-black powder, and there were fine beads of sweat on his forehead.
With each forceful pounding of the pestle, the stone mortar made a dull and rhythmic "dong...dong..." sound, and fine dust danced in the light.
Zou Yun seemed to be isolated from the outside world and immersed in his own world.
"What you want!"
Fusu walked straight to Zou Yun, leaned down, and handed the package to his hand.
Even in such a situation, his movements still carried a kind of etiquette and grace.
Meng Yi followed closely behind, scanning the surroundings, alert to any possible changes.
Zou Yun didn't even raise his head, as if he had already known their arrival, and directly reached out to take the things.
And without looking at it, he poured it directly into the other two stone mortars, and then started grinding even harder.
The pestle rod rubs against the hard mineral, making a harsh "crunching" sound.
Seeing that he was completely immersed in the thing at hand and turned a deaf ear to the outside world. Fusu couldn't help but take a few steps closer, bent down and stared at Shijiu with an incomprehensible expression:
"Master Alchemist, what are you trying to do? Could it be...that this is the secret technique used by alchemists to pursue immortality?"
The sudden explosion in his ears made Zou Yun tremble. His hand shook so hard that he almost knocked over the stone mortar.
"What the hell?!"
Zou Yun suddenly raised his head, more sweat broke out on his forehead, and his eyes were full of confusion after being frightened.
After seeing clearly that it was the two people just now, the confusion was quickly replaced by displeasure.
"Why haven't you left yet?! Didn't you tell me not to ask questions?"
Zou Yun frowned and spoke in a hurried and irritable tone, obviously extremely dissatisfied with Fusu's sudden question.
Fusu was also startled by his excessive reaction, and subconsciously took half a step back.
The eldest son, who has always been gentle and elegant, obviously did not expect that the other party would be so rude.
But staring at the sullen look in Zou Yun's eyes, Fusu immediately realized his abruptness, and a trace of apology flashed across his face.
"I took the liberty of disturbing Master Fang. Please forgive me."
Then he apologized to Zou Yun again and again with his hands in a very low posture.
"That's all!"
Seeing Fusu's humble and sincere attitude, most of the anger in Zou Yun's chest was gone. He waved his hand slightly impatiently to dismiss the matter.
Just when Fusu breathed a sigh of relief and continued to observe the movements of Zou Yun's hands.
Suddenly, Zou Yun casually pointed to the stone mortar next to him, signaling Fusu to grind another piece of material.
"Here, I am idle, go and grind that pile too!" At the end, he did not forget to emphasize, "Be fine, the finer the better!"
That tone seemed to be instructing an apprentice.
"Huh?..."
Fusu obviously did not expect such a move, and a trace of astonishment flashed across his face.
But before he could say his polite refusal, a stone mortar covered with mineral powder was involuntarily thrust into his arms.
The cold rough feeling spread to him through the silk, and the choking dust instantly polluted the luxurious robe on his body.
The heavy touch of the stone mortar made this pampered young man stagger under the pressure, and he could hardly stand still.
"Why are you standing there, go quickly!!"
But Zou Yun just urged impatiently, as if Fusu's hesitation had delayed his important task.
Faced with this almost rude urging, the eldest son of Qin, who had always abided by etiquette, was unexpectedly stunned for a moment.
